notes.title: Finally ~! We have the account permission to apply back ~!
notes.content:
I am Zero, producer at DKS Studio, and we have finally regained control of the developer account for the Steam edition of Survival!

Formal Apology
First and foremost, we extend our deepest apologies to all Steam players. Due to critical lapses in our publishing management, the Steam version of Survival: Live Through had been left unmaintained, leaving our studio unable to intervene.

The current Steam version has completely lost access to game servers and online features. Moreover, as the game was originally designed for mobile devices, the PC port suffers from severe control incompatibility. We are now actively learning Steam's delisting procedures and coordinating with Bluestacks representatives to address these issues.

Current Progress
Through negotiations with Steam and Bluestacks:
✓ Developer account permissions successfully restored
✓ Verified 6,242 active user profiles on Steam (including 50 accounts with purchase history)

Next Steps
① Collaborating with developer Try to design:
Data migration and preservation solutions
Account verification systems
② Initiating delisting procedures for the incompatible PC version

Special Note
To all 6,242 survivors who have stayed with us:
Every minute of your perseverance fuels our determination
Every act of trust through purchases drives us forward

On behalf of the entire DKS Studio team,
We offer our sincerest apologies and gratitude.

Producer: Zero
February 25, 2025
